caption: The drawing features a single object positioned in the center of a mostly empty, off-white background. The object is a truncated, rectangular prism with a small cylindrical knob on its top. The body of the object is rendered in shades of brown with areas of darker shadow, while the top section and knob are a dark brown or almost black color, appearing as if the top is painted or coated differently from the sides. The object’s sides show variations in tone, indicating light and shadow. There are no other objects or elements present in the drawing, and the background remains plain and unembellished except for a faint rectangular border framing the object and a signature, "L. W. Jordan," near the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Ink Bottle
